summary: Public ask surface: anonymous entry that streams the real Guru answer with citations
description: Depends on the guest API + proxy allowlist. Public route OUTSIDE the (app) Clerk gate (e.g. /ask) rendering a chat entry that POSTs /api/query/guest and streams the answer with full citations — reuse chat-view.tsx machinery or a trimmed variant, not a bespoke demo. Landing copy: 'Ask Guru anything.' The answer must look identical to the authenticated product.

resolution.note: src/app/ask (page+layout), src/components/ask-view.tsx (streams /api/query/guest, reuses ReactMarkdown+remarkCiteLinks+MD_COMPONENTS+Citation), src/components/guest-wall.tsx. Static-render tests; streaming covered at API layer.
